item.title: FTC Acts Against Operators of Cryptocurrency Investment Scam Targeting Older Adults
item.description: The FTC charged operators of a scheme that used romance and investment lures to defraud older adults of millions in cryptocurrency.

item.title: FTC Warns Consumers About Surge in Business Email Compromise Scams
item.description: Scammers impersonate executives and vendors to redirect corporate payments to fraudulent accounts.

item.title: Operators of Gift-Card Refund Scam Banned from Telemarketing
item.description: Defendants instructed victims to pay supposed fees via retail gift cards.
